items.title: Jack Palmer interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, September 24, 1997
items.q: Third trumpet player played third, and occasional easy first parts, so that the first trumpet player could take a break on the third part.

ctx.x: Second trumpet chair was always the ride chair. First trumpet just played first trumpet that’s what he did. Third trumpet player played third, and occasional easy first parts, so that the first trumpet player could take a break on the third part.
So you went with Harry James then.
